name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russian strikes hit Kharkiv, Kyiv and Dnipro on 3 Nov, a day after bombs killed 26 at a Zaporizhzhia aid point
state: Russian aerial bombs hit a shelter and aid point in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region, on 2 Nov, killing at least 26 people, according to Ukrainian officials (AP). Overnight into 3 Nov a strike wounded 25 at a medical facility in Kharkiv, and Dnipro and Kryvyi Rih were hit; Moscow's mayor said nearly 500 drones heading for the capital were downed (AFP). US envoy Witkoff said talks would resume the following week.
for_you: Travel to Ukraine is against FCDO advice. Energy and grain markets remain sensitive to the war.
